title: 第十二章 两月成果第十三章 脱胎换骨老张归来
content_zh:
将黄庭经放回原处，林凡离开了藏经阁。
抬起头，星辰格外明亮，好似就在头顶。
碧空如洗！
林凡忽然想到了这个词。
回到院子里，有一个道童早已等候。
桌子上放着一个食盒，里面是药膳。
喝完之后，演练五行拳。
这一套拳法虽领悟了神髓，可如今修炼，却又有了更深的体悟。拳法演化，从勃勃生机之间，陡然化作燥烈狂暴，随之又变得厚重无边、十分沉重，转换之时竟然有了锐利之气。
忽而腾挪，轻缓如水之善变柔顺。
五行拳，有了五行道韵。
时间如指尖沙，缓缓流淌。
距离降临时，已经过去两个月。
林凡也彻底喜欢上了山上的生活，安逸无争，看书修炼，没有俗事之烦扰，也无红尘之欲念沟壑。
他有了几分‘宠辱不惊，闲看庭前花开花落；去留无意，漫随天外云卷云舒’的淡然。
这天上午，他踏上楼梯，来到了二楼。
一楼藏书，终究被他看完了。
用俞岱岩的话来说，我们武当终究还是势力不强，人数太少，以至于收集的经书都不多。
远远不及少林，更不及皇家百分之一。
说者无意，林凡却留上了心。
“小师叔，你终于上楼了！”在这里翻阅功法的宋青书听到动静，看过来发现是他，不禁喜道，“都看完了？”

“看完了！”林凡点头。
“记住了？”
“七七八八！”
“理解了？”
“通透一二。”
“你、你牛逼！”
尽管早有所料，宋青书还是差点骂娘。
自从读书习字后，他就没少来藏经阁。
最近每天也都翻阅，可到了现在，他连十分之一都没看完，更别说理解了。
“我是你小师叔，当然牛逼。”林凡笑道。
也只有他自己知道。
若不是开挂，他都不一定能够看进去。
可现在完全不同了。
随着悟性提升，他不但过目不忘，就连理解力也达到了极高层次，现在完全可以用‘心灵透彻不染尘，道心通明悟真法’来形容。
他目光一凝，虚拟屏幕出现在眼前。
content_en:
Lin Fan put the Huang Ting Sutra back to its original place and left the Sutra Collection Pavilion.
When I raised my head, the stars were exceptionally bright, as if they were right above my head.
The sky is clear and blue!
Lin Fan suddenly thought of this word.
Back in the yard, a Taoist boy was waiting for him.
There is a food box on the table with medicinal food inside.
After drinking, practice Five Elements Boxing.
Although I have understood the essence of this set of boxing techniques, now that I am practicing, I have gained a deeper understanding. The boxing technique evolved from vigorous and vigorous to violent and violent, and then became thick and heavy, with a sharp energy during the transition.
Suddenly it moves, as gently and smoothly as water.
Five Elements Boxing has the rhyme of Five Elements Dao.
Time flows slowly like sand on fingertips.
Two months have passed since the day of arrival.
Lin Fan also completely fell in love with the life in the mountains. It was comfortable and free from strife, reading books and practicing, without the worries of worldly things, and without the ravages of desire in the world of mortals.
He had a bit of indifference like "not surprised by favor or disgrace, just watching the flowers blooming and falling in front of the court; leaving or leaving unintentionally, just following the clouds rolling and relaxing in the sky".
This morning, he stepped up the stairs and arrived at the second floor.
The books on the first floor were finally read by him.
In Yu Daiyan's words, after all, our Wudang is still not very powerful and has too few people to collect many scriptures.
Far less than Shaolin, let alone one percent as good as the royal family.
The speaker didn't mean it, but Lin Fan took it seriously.
"Uncle Master, you finally went upstairs!" Song Qingshu, who was browsing the exercises here, heard the movement, looked over and saw that it was him, and couldn't help but said with joy, "Have you finished reading them all?"
"I've finished reading!" Lin Fan nodded.
"Remember?"
"Seven, seven, eight, eight!"
"Understood?"
"Transparent one or two."
"You, you are awesome!"
Even though he had expected it, Song Qingshu almost cursed her.
Ever since he started studying and practicing calligraphy, he had come to the Sutra Pavilion frequently.
Recently, he has been reading it every day, but now, he has not even read a tenth of it, let alone understood it.
"I'm your junior uncle, so of course I'm awesome." Lin Fan said with a smile.
Only he himself knows.
If it weren't for cheating, he might not even be able to see through.
But now it's completely different.
As his understanding improves, not only does he have a photographic memory, but his understanding has also reached a very high level. Now it can be described as 'a penetrating mind untainted by dust, a clear Taoist heart and understanding of the true Dharma'.
His eyes narrowed, and a virtual screen appeared in front of him.
